1. **First Semester:** Courses pre-selected by system. Electives chosen by student.
2. **Credit Hours Limits:**
 * Maximum **18 credit hours** per semester (Except $5^{\text{th}}$ semester: **21 credit hours**).
 * Math Deficiency Students: **21 credit hours** ($1^{\text{st}}$ semester) and **20 credit hours** ($2^{\text{nd}}$ semester).
 * **VU001** is mandatory to enroll and qualify.
 * Last 2 Semesters Extra Load: Request for 1 extra course beyond credit limit must be submitted to Rector via Dean (Requires CGPA $\ge 3.00$).
 * Final Semester: Maximum 21 credit hours coursework allowed in addition to Project/Internship if degree completes in same term.
 * Minimum Load: According to study scheme (minimum 3 credit hours under special circumstances).
3. **Theory & Practical Co-requisites:**
 * Select theory and practical course in same semester. If student fails one component, they can re-enroll in failed course component only.

1. Log into **VU LMS** $\rightarrow$ Click **Student Services**.
2. Click **Course Selection**.
3. Prioritize failed ("F") courses and grade improvements.
4. Select course checkboxes and **Save**.
5. Changes permitted until published add/drop deadline.

* **Two Exams per Semester:** Each course has a Mid-Term (60 mins) and an End-Semester/Final-Term (120 mins) examination.
* **Passing Criteria (20% Rule):**
 * Must secure at least **20% marks** in the final/mid-term exam.
 * Must secure at least **20% aggregate marks** across continuous assessments (assignments, quizzes, GDBs).
 * Overall passing score: Minimum **40%**.

---

* **No Communication:** Talking or sharing information leads to immediate paper cancellation.
* **Entrance Slip Restrictions:** Writing anything on your Exam Entrance Slip counts as Unfair Means (UM).
* **Seat and Attendance:** Must sign the official attendance sheet; no leaving your seat without permission from the superintendent.
* **Departure:** Leave the examination center immediately after paper completion.

---

* **Timing & Location:** Follows Pakistan Standard Time (PST). Must be physically located outside Pakistan.
* **Workspace Setup:**
 * Desk restricted to 1 computer, 1 monitor, 1 wired keyboard, and 1 wired mouse.
 * **External USB webcam mandatory** (built-in laptop cameras are strictly prohibited).
* **Pre-Exam Check:** Run VUTES software and remote connection apps (AnyDesk / AnyViewer) 20 minutes before test time.
* **Strict Prohibitions:** No one else in the room, earplugs/phones banned, reading questions aloud strictly forbidden.

* **Entry Test Fee:** Rs. 1,000 (where applicable, non-refundable).
* **Degree Verification Fee:** Included in one-time Admission Fee.
* **Lab Fee for Practicals (Per Credit Hour):**
 * BS / Bachelors / Associate / Diploma (CS Programs): **Rs. 2,150**
 * BS / Masters / Zero Semester (Bio Sciences): **Rs. 3,200**
 * MS (Bio Sciences): **Rs. 5,350**
* **Thesis Fee (Flat Rate):** MS @ Rs. 15,000 | Ph.D @ Rs. 25,000.
* **Research Fee:** MS (Bioinformatics, Biotech, Genetics, Zoology, Molecular Biology) @ Rs. 25,000 | Ph.D @ Rs. 50,000.
* **Recurring Dues:**
 * Convocation Fee: Rs. 2,000 (Mandatory at pass-out).
 * Endowment Fund Contribution: Rs. 1,000 (One-time).
 * Fee Collection Charges: Rs. 100 / semester.
 * Societies, Clubs & Sports Fee: Rs. 500 / semester.

* **Title:** Student Scholarship Regulations, 2015 (supersedes Student Scholarship Regulation, 2010).
* **Commencement:** Effective from Fall 2015 semester.
* **Application:** Applies to regular students of Virtual University of Pakistan registered across all degree programs.

* **Board:** Board of Governors of Virtual University of Pakistan.
* **Management Committee:** Comprises Registrar (Chairman), Controller of Examinations (Member), Two Regional Campus Managers nominated by Rector (Members), and Director Finance (Member/Secretary).
* **Quorum:** Minimum 3 members present in person. Meets at least twice during an academic year.

---

* Comprises partial or full remission of applicable tuition fee only; students must pay all other dues.
* Valid for **one semester** only.
* **Ineligibility:** Receiving scholarship/financial aid from another source, or holding course exemptions.
* Must not have any repeat/fail course(s).
* **Termination:** Immediately terminated if student freezes, withdraws, discontinues studies, or is convicted in any unfair means (UM)/disciplinary case.

* **Eligibility:** Minimum 65% marks OR CGPA $\ge 3.00 / 4.00$ (or $4.00 / 5.00$).
* **Allocation:** 1 scholarship per 50 students (Max 10 per program).
* **Tie-Breaking:** Evaluated on preceding examination performance, then by age (younger student preferred).

* Must accumulate equal or higher credits as prescribed in scheme of study.
* **Eligibility:** Semester GPA $\ge 3.25$ with CGPA $\ge 3.00$.
* **Allocation:** 1 scholarship per 50 students (Max 10 per program).
* **Tie-Breaking:** Evaluated on overall semester percentage marks, then by age (younger student preferred).

---

* Remission of tuition fee only; restricted to **local students**.
* Valid for **one semester**.
* Ineligible if holding exemptions, receiving other financial aid, or having failed/repeat courses.
* Subject to annual budget allocation determined by Management Committee.

* Must apply on prescribed form at time of admission application.
* **Eligibility:** Minimum 60% marks OR CGPA $\ge 2.50 / 4.00$ (or $3.50 / 5.00$).

* Must accumulate required credit hours per scheme of study.
* **Maintenance:** Semester GPA $\ge 2.25$ with CGPA $\ge 2.50$.
* If withdrawn due to GPA drop, scholarship resumes automatically once required CGPA $\ge 2.50$ is restored (subject to fund availability).

* **Orientation:** Mandatory watching of orientation videos to understand Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* **Account Security:** Mandatory regular password updates; sharing passwords is strictly prohibited.
* **Profile Verification:** Verify Name, Father’s Name, Date of Birth (as per Matriculation Result Card), and CNIC Number within **30 days** of class commencement via `studentprofile@vu.edu.pk`.
* **Campus Transfer:** Allowed within **30 days** of the start of the semester.
* **Semester Freezing Policy:**
 * Maximum 1 freeze per semester.
 * Maximum of 2 consecutive semesters frozen.
 * Failing to resume by the 3rd semester results in an automated **"Withdrawn"** status requiring new admission.
* **Attendance & LMS:** Mandatory daily login to record attendance and check Notice Board updates.
* **Practicals:** Conducted exclusively at VU-designated laboratories.
